const values = [...123] as const;
const lengths = [...{ length: 2 }] as const;
const head: [number, ...number[]] = [1, ...5];
function count(...xs: number[]) { return xs.length; }
console.log(count(...[...5]));
console.log(count(...[1, ...[2, 3]]));
const mixed: [string, ...number[]] = ["a", ...new Set([1, 2])];
const chars = [..."ab", ...([1, 2] as const)] as const;
const flags: readonly [number, ...string[]] = [1, ...true];
const loose: any = [1];
const copied = [...loose] as const;
console.log(values, lengths, head, mixed, chars, flags, copied);
